history_summary.value: Developed by Karnataka Veterinary, Animal and Fisheries Sciences University in Bengaluru by crossing purebred exotic lines to resemble native desi birds. It is a dual-purpose breed suited to backyard and free-range farming, growing faster than local varieties while still needing little special care.
